title: Docs smoke check
description: Checks a deployed docs site (ADR-0028): pages without trailing-slash redirects and their slashed and .html forms redirecting to them, the 404 page with a 404 status, /r/index.json as fresh JSON, a theme URL served by the Function, /sw.js, and, in Chromium, that the service worker registers and leaves /r/ uncached.

url.description: The deployment's origin, such as https://ndop.dev or a preview URL.

browser.description: Also check the service worker in Playwright's Chromium.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the site to answer, and for the service worker to take control.
